title: Add typed mechanics for all core SRD action records
description:
Finding sources:
- ChatGPT found 9/10 action records lack data.mechanics; only Dodge has a mechanics projection.
- Codex cited action:help as an example likely needing deterministic mechanics.
- Fable's field-frequency scan independently confirms: kind=action has mechanics on exactly 1 of 10 records.

Scope:
- Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, Use an Object.

Acceptance criteria:
- Each action has typed action-economy and effect semantics.
- Cover: extra movement from Dash, opportunity-attack prevention from Disengage, Help advantage timing and target constraints, Ready trigger/reaction behavior and spell-concentration caveat, Hide and Search check linkage, Attack and Cast a Spell action semantics, Use an Object interaction boundaries, and Dodge existing semantics.
- Add tests for all 10 action records.
close_reason: Added typed action-economy and effect mechanics for all ten SRD action records; regenerated pack and covered importer/committed-pack tests.
